results.title: Veterans Azriyn-Wee Kiong march into China Masters semis
results.description: PETALING JAYA: Veteran men's doubles pair Nur Azriyn Ayub-Tan Wee Kiong showed they still have plenty left in the tank after booking a place in the China Masters semi-finals on Friday (Sept 4).
